zb build hello.lua
stdout ^$ZB_STORE_DIR
[!windows] stderr '^hi from builder$'
[windows] stderr '^hi from builder\r\n'
read resultPath
grep '\AHello, World!\n\z' $resultPath
[!windows] grep '\AHello, World!\n\z' result

-- hello.lua --
return setmetatable({}, {
  __outputs = function(self, system)
    local builder, args
    if system:match("-windows$") then
      builder = [[C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe]]
      args = {
        "-Command",
        [[Write-Output "hi from builder" ; "Hello, World!`n" | Out-File -NoNewline -Encoding ascii -FilePath ${env:out}]],
      }
    else
      builder = "/bin/sh"
      args = {
        "-c",
        [[echo 'hi from builder' ; echo 'Hello, World!' > $out]],
      }
    end
    return (derivation {
      name = "hello.txt";
      builder = builder;
      args = args;
      system = system;
    }).out
  end;
})
